hail.text:
He is still on the pallet. The lamp is still lit.

"You told her. That's more than most. I'm not coming up."

A man about Brenna's age, thinner, sitting on a pallet with his back to the wall the way she sits upstairs.

"You're from the house. Tell Brenna I'm not lost. I stayed. That's different."

choices.label: She asked me to find you.

notice.text:
"I know she did. I wrote her a note the first time and she sent someone anyway."

He looks at the lamp.

"This used to be work, and worship, and a watch. The house is what's left of it. I'm keeping this end. Tell her that. Use the word if she needs it."

come.text:
"No. I stayed. That's the whole of it. She can hate it. She already does."

"Tell her the watch held. She'll know what that costs."

told.text: "Go up. The stair's still there. I won't be."
